note: Commits on origin/main AFTER the v1.104.1 tag that fix security issues PRESENT in the installed 1.104.1 binary. Most reference tailscale/corp#50380 (a coordinated hardening batch, 11/14 in ssh/tailssh). These are known/fixed upstream => not themselves bounty-eligible; value is (a) incomplete-fix check, (b) same-pattern-unfixed-elsewhere.

high_interest.bug_in_1.104.1: SSH accepts client env (TERM/LANG/LC_*) with unvalidated values reaching root su/login env; GLIBC_TUNABLES not denylisted (CVE-2023-4911 class priv-esc). Also acceptEnv name matching not length-capped.
acceptEnv pattern matching not linear time -> potential ReDoS/CPU DoS via crafted env var names.
off-by-one + unclamped c2n SSH username hint cap.
direct-exec fallback for non-root users while running as root (priv context).
numerically-zero uids not treated as root in isRootUser (authz).
private host keys not written 0600 (local info disclosure).

serve app capabilities stored on connection-scoped serveHTTPContext shared by concurrent h2 streams -> Tailscale-App-Capabilities header can leak across mounts, authorizing wrong mount at a trusting backend.
'id -G <user>' and getent passwd parsing: crafted username like '-u' treated as option; 8-field/corrupt passwd shifts fields (home<->shell).
Compare panics on numeric version field >= 20 digits (overflow uint64) -> DoS where caller compares attacker-influenced version strings.

hunting_patterns: connection-scoped struct carrying per-request state shared across concurrent h2 streams (serveHTTPContext pattern) elsewhere
exec of system tools with attacker-influenced argv lacking leading-dash guards (osuser pattern)
untrusted strings reaching strconv.ParseUint/Atoi without error handling -> panic
env/arg propagation into privileged child processes
